en.title: The Odyssey Officially Becomes Biggest R-Rated Movie Ever, Topping Deadpool & Wolverine
en.summary: Christopher Nolan's epic journey has sailed past all expectations, officially becoming the highest-grossing R-rated film globally. The monumental achievement dethrones a previous box office titan and solidifies its place in cinema history.
en.body:
The box office has a new king of R-rated cinema, and its name is **The Odyssey**. Christopher Nolan's ambitious epic has officially sailed past the $1.34 billion mark globally, dethroning **Deadpool & Wolverine** to claim the title of the highest-grossing R-rated movie of all time. This monumental achievement is a testament to Nolan's directorial prowess and the audience's hunger for grand, original cinematic experiences that push boundaries.

The film's global success is staggering, with $516 million from domestic territories and an impressive $835 million from international markets. This makes **The Odyssey** not only Nolan's biggest hit to date but also a significant entry into the exclusive club of R-rated films that have crossed the billion-dollar threshold, joining the ranks of **Joker** and **Oppenheimer**. The film's journey to the top has been remarkable, defying expectations and proving that audiences are willing to flock to theaters for ambitious, adult-oriented blockbusters.

## A New Box Office Champion

The numbers speak for themselves: **The Odyssey** has achieved what many thought impossible in the current cinematic landscape. Its global haul of $1.34 billion has officially surpassed the previous record holder, **Deadpool & Wolverine**, which garnered $1.33 billion worldwide. This victory is particularly sweet for Nolan, whose film has resonated with audiences on a massive scale. The film's success also underscores the ongoing resurgence of the theatrical experience, demonstrating that compelling narratives and stunning visuals can still draw massive crowds, even in an era dominated by streaming.

## Fan Reaction and the Road Ahead

The news has sent waves of excitement through the fan community. Many are celebrating the film's ability to achieve such monumental success without relying on established IP or franchise fatigue. The sheer scale and narrative depth of **The Odyssey** have clearly struck a chord. As **Ryan Reynolds**, star of **Deadpool & Wolverine**, humorously acknowledged on social media, "Congratulations to the entire cast and crew of **The Odyssey** for becoming the highest grossing R-rated movie of all time. That is one helluva car." This good-natured nod from a rival highlights the shared celebration within the industry for such impressive box office milestones.

## What's Next

With **The Odyssey** firmly cemented as the highest-grossing R-rated film ever, the focus now shifts to its legacy. The film's success is a powerful indicator for the future of blockbuster filmmaking, suggesting a continued appetite for original, critically acclaimed R-rated features. As audiences continue to embrace these grand cinematic events, the industry will undoubtedly be watching closely to see what ambitious projects will follow in its wake.

content_raw: Despite the backlash from the world’s richest man and Homer’s most popular translators , Christopher Nolan’s The Odyssey crossed yet another milestone today. After amassing $1.35 billion at the global box office, the film is now the highest-grossing R-rated movie of all time, per Variety . The film has supplanted another Odyssey-heavy movie, Deadpool & Wolverine , which prominently featured Honda’s affordable minivan, to the tune of $1.38 million. The Odyssey has made $516 million domestically and $835 million internationally, making it not only the biggest R-rated movie ever, but Nolan’s biggest hit. It’s also the third R-rated movie to enter the prestigious club, which also counts Joker as a member, making Odyssey the first good R-rated movie to do so.  The box office is having a major comeback this year, following a lumbering and seemingly endless COVID recovery period. It’s also dealing with the fact that 2019, which saw Disney release Avengers: Endgame , Spider-Man: No Way Home , Star Wars: The Rise Of Skywalker , and Toy Story 4 , set too high a bar for the post-strike Hollywood to compete with. Nevertheless, The Odyssey is now the fifth movie to enter the billionaires club this year, joining Brand New Day , Toy Story 5 , Michael , and The Super Mario Galaxy Movie . Adding more fuel to Troy’s fire, 2026 still has yet another Cyclops-starring blockbuster on the way: Avengers: Doomsday . Six of the highest-grossing movies ever in a single year should help continue bolstering the case for selling tickets to movies in expensive theaters as a way to make lots and lots of money, a business strategy that has fallen out of favor in recent years.
